summary: FIR quashing appeal; 14-year delay in FIR registration unexplained; offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 342, 386, 504, 506 IPC; fraudulent directorship allegation; harassment through repeated FIRs; HC rejected quashing citing multiple criminal cases; standard: pre-investigation quashing inappropriate when offences apparent; appeal dismissed; FIR not quashed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court order upholding FIR upheld; FIR not quashed.
